svg.aria-label: One band of PR Board, annotated. The band names the category, its repositories, how many open PRs it has per colour and how many merged ones. Each row has a left bar coloured by what the PR still needs, its number, the repository and the branch it merges into, the title without its category tag, the signal chips and the next step; a PR that waits on another sits under it with an elbow and an after #412 label. Below, the bar colours and every signal chip with its meaning, taken from the page's legend.
